knowledge:
- key_parameters: inputFile=Path to the SDS input file containing individual Ct values ;; referenceGene=Housekeeping gene(s) to use for normalization ;; referenceSample=Calibration/reference sample(s) to use ;; threshold=Upper boundary for Ct values (values above this are treated as undetermined) ;; mode=Summarization method for replicates ("mean" or "median") ;; efficiencies=Optional amplification efficiencies for each gene ;; ttestPerform=Logical indicating whether to perform t-test/Wilcoxon test
- alternatives: Writing custom R scripts using low-level functions (like ddCtExpression or ddCtwithE) instead of the high-level ddCtExec wrapper for greater flexibility.
- when_to_use: Appropriate for relative quantification of qRT-PCR data using the 2^-ddCt method when technical replicates, housekeeping genes, and reference/calibration samples are present.
- pitfalls: If gene or sample names are renamed using aliases, the new names must be used for all subsequent parameters ;; If efficiencies are used, no dCt or ddCt values are calculated, and no t-test can be performed ;; The first column of the sample annotation file must be named exactly 'Sample' ;; Plot legends can sometimes distort the plot layout, requiring legende=FALSE ;; Individual Ct values must be exported from the PCR software, not pre-combined replicates.

workflows.name: ddct_high_level_pipeline
workflows.intent: Run the end-to-end ddCt analysis pipeline using a single parameter list and the high-level wrapper function ddCtExec.
input: Experiment1.txt (SDS input file with Ct values)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the ddCt script and set up the parameter list ;; 2. Specify input/output paths and files ;; 3. Define housekeeping genes, reference samples, threshold, and calculation mode ;; 4. Configure optional plotting and t-test parameters ;; 5. Execute the pipeline using ddCtExec.
workflows.code:
source(system.file("scripts", "ddCt.R", package="ddCt"))
params <- list(loadPath = system.file("extdata", package="ddCt"), savePath = getwd())  
params$confFile <- system.file("scripts", "ddCt.conf", package="ddCt")
params$inputFile <- c("Experiment1.txt")
params$sampleAnnotationFile = NULL
params$columnForGrouping    = NULL
params$onlyFromAnnotation   = FALSE
params$referenceGene <- c("Gene1", "Gene2")
params$referenceSample <- c("Sample1")
params$threshold <- 40
params$mode = "median"
params$plotMode = c("level","Ct")
params$genesRemainInOutput   = NULL
params$samplesRemainInOutput = NULL
params$genesNotInOutput   = NULL
params$samplesNotInOutput = NULL
params$groupingBySamples = FALSE
params$plotPerObject = TRUE
params$legende  = TRUE
params$ttestPerform = FALSE
ddCtExec(params)

workflows.name: ddct_step_by_step_analysis
workflows.intent: Perform step-by-step qRT-PCR data loading, filtering, relative expression calculation, and visualization using low-level functions.
input: Experiment1.txt (SDS input file with Ct values)
workflows.stages: 1. Load data into an SDMFrame object ;; 2. Read sample annotation metadata ;; 3. Calculate relative expression using ddCtExpression ;; 4. Export results using elistWrite ;; 5. Visualize results using errBarchart.
workflows.code:
library(Biobase)
library(lattice)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ddCt)
CtData <- SDMFrame(file.names)
sampleInformation <- read.AnnotatedDataFrame(info,header=TRUE, row.names=NULL)
result <- ddCtExpression(CtData, calibrationSample=name.reference.sample, housekeepingGene=name.reference.gene, sampleInformation=sampleInformation, warningStream=warningFile)
elistWrite(result,file=savedir("allValues.txt"))
br <- errBarchart(result)
print(br)
